title: How One Rule for Every Room Keeps a Godly Man From Splitting in Two
caption:
A godly man doesn't have a church face.

Same guy in the group chat, the gym, and the front row. A different face for every room is how you split into a guy nobody actually knows, not even you.

Notice what changes when you walk in somewhere. The volume. The jokes. What you'll say yes to. If something has to change, that something was never really you.

Give one man access to every version of you. A secret with a witness starts losing its grip.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #integrity #brotherhood #discipleship
